premises.text: Talk media (podcasts/radio) remain long, non-interactive, and poorly suited to mobile-first, short-attention creators unlike reinvented music/photos/video
premises.evidence_span: They're long. They're not interactive. They don't really cater to the ADD generation, the mobile-first content creators

premises.text: Pundit is a social network for bite-sized talk shows where users start short conversations and invite friends/followers to participate with max ~30-second replies
premises.evidence_span: a social network for voice experiences, where users can start bite-sized talk shows about their favorite topics and invite their friends or followers to participate

premises.text: Recording auto-cleans audio and supports voice filters and background music to make spoken content sound fun
premises.evidence_span: Pundit will automatically reduce the background noise and engineer your voice to make you sound your best

premises.text: Pundit Voice Box sends private voice messages that disappear in 24 hours
premises.evidence_span: you can send private voice messages that disappear in 24 hours

premises.text: Creators can share and natively embed talks across social platforms and the web, including brand/cast AMAs that fans can join without the app
premises.evidence_span: creators can share their Pundit talks on other social platforms and natively embed them on any website

premises.text: Expansion via Android and launches in Asian and Middle Eastern markets where voice interaction is already dominant
premises.evidence_span: Pundit will also be releasing our Android version and launching in Asian and Middle Eastern markets

value.text: Make talk lightweight, interactive, and fun like Snapchat did for photos
value.evidence_span: making talk more lightweight, interactive, and fun

causal_links.evidence_span: what about talk, the voice, the podcast, the radio? You know, it's still behind
you can create short, insanely fun audio content
this opened a new world of possibilities for brands and top-notch creators

notes: Voice filters/music treated as facets of fun recording polish (v1.5.1 §4.1.7); Voice Box kept separate as privately revisable messaging module. Engagement metrics and Comic-Con fan counts excluded. Anti-template: problem, product, and distribution/expansion separately revisable.
